bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Board of Animal Health.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BOARD OF ANIMAL HEALTH. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Animal Health for the purposes of carrying out the board's duties under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 35. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Board of Animal Health.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BOARD OF ANIMAL HEALTH.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Animal Health for the purposes of carrying out the board's duties under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 35.
additions: $....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Animal Health for the purposes of carrying out the board's duties under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 35.
